title: EAL/2 developer and model handover study
question: Does the EAL/2 workflow improve correct engineering decisions within a fixed time budget in a new prompt session, and reduce time and repeated work, when developers and models change?

scope.system_or_population: Selected real developer teams, engineering cases and pinned model versions in a run plan.
scope.conditions: Two consecutive sessions; four same/different developer and model strata; isolated project copies; equal elapsed-time and model-call budgets across arms.
scope.spatial_scope: Instrumented development workspaces selected for the trial.
scope.temporal_scope: Initial work and one later question; trial dates to be declared in its plan.
exclusions: No claim about all small or large models.
No multi-session amortisation or component-mechanism claim.
Synthetic fixtures are software checks only.

claims.statement: Assignment to the EAL/2 workflow increases time-bounded later decision correctness by more than the predeclared practical threshold in the selected different-developer/different-model cases.
claims.scope_limit: Average bundle effect in the selected cases and eligible teams under the tested adapter configurations.
claims.success_consequence: Support a bounded correctness benefit; report time and cost separately.
claims.failure_consequence: Report adverse or inconclusive results without treating nonsignificance as equivalence.

claims.statement: Assignment to EAL/2 changes restricted time to a correct submitted decision and total active effort across the two sessions.
claims.scope_limit: Descriptive secondary estimates; no success-only analysis or simultaneous confirmatory inference.
claims.success_consequence: Quantify time and effort changes including authoring.
claims.failure_consequence: Retain initial cost and failures in the estimates.

assumptions.statement: No cross-case interference, shared mutable tool state, cross-arm learning or undisclosed session memory.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Distinct confirmation developers across cases, isolated projects and fresh transcripts; procedural checks for human spillover.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Cross-case inference and causal interpretation are withheld if violated.

assumptions.statement: Independent reference answers and masked assessors validly identify correct scoped decisions.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Calibrate raters on known correct, wrong, ambiguous and qualified-unresolved cases before live trials.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Invalid references or measurements suspend the confirmatory conclusion.

assumptions.statement: Participants use recorded model/tool paths; the session clock measures the declared elapsed-time outcome.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Operator release at readiness, recorded timestamps, deadline and call-limit tests; supervise undisclosed tool use.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Report deviations and withhold inference when treatment or endpoint cannot be reconstructed.

hypotheses.label: Meaningful workflow benefit
hypotheses.statement: Reusable EAL knowledge and delegated assessment enable a practically larger fraction of correct later decisions within the same time budget, including authoring in initial effort.
hypotheses.scope: Average bundle effect in the selected cases and eligible teams under the tested adapter configurations.

hypotheses.label: No meaningful workflow benefit
hypotheses.statement: Ordinary new-session work is sufficiently effective, or EAL overhead sufficiently large, that EAL does not exceed the declared practical correctness gain.
hypotheses.scope: Average bundle effect in the selected cases and eligible teams under the tested adapter configurations.

predictions.expected_pattern: A positive average causal difference exceeding the run plan meaningful_difference, conditional on assumptions.
predictions.magnitude_or_range: Delta greater than the plan practical threshold; a confirmation interval must lie wholly above it.
predictions.time_window: Later submitted decisions within the declared deadline.
predictions.tolerance: Two-sided 95% conservative finite-sample interval; unknown outcomes bounded.

constructs.name: Time-bounded scoped correctness
constructs.definition: Final submitted decision matches an independently justified answer, includes material qualifications, and contains no material unsupported claim, before the deadline.
constructs.scope: Selected tasks and fixed session budget
validity_evidence: Reference and scorer calibration are required before a live run; currently planned.
validity_threats: Correct outputs that omit essential scope

constructs.name: Time and work required
constructs.definition: Restricted elapsed time to a correct final submission, plus separately reported active effort, calls, usage and tool collection.
constructs.scope: Initial and later sessions; no inference about unobserved later reuse.
validity_evidence: Timestamp, failure and reuse paths are checked synthetically.
validity_threats: Treating elapsed waiting as active work

measurements.observable: Submitted answer, timing and independent correctness/material-error ratings; explicit nonresponse status.
measurements.instrument_or_procedure: StudyRun submission/closure; two nonparticipant assessors and independent third adjudicator when ratings differ.
measurements.scale_or_units: Binary correctness; unknown outcome represented by [0,1].
measurements.timing: Every allocated initial/later session reaches one terminal record.
measurements.preprocessing: Correct and on-time is one; wrong, late or no_answer is zero. withdrawn is unknown. invalid_measurement blocks confirmation.
measurements.calibration: Before live trials: independently justified examples of correct, wrong, scope-deficient, unresolved and borderline answers; resolve rubric failures before allocation.
measurements.reliability: Retain both ratings, reasons and adjudications; report disagreement counts. Agreement does not establish validity.
measurements.validity: Task authors establish references independently of EAL output. Human calibration remains outstanding.
measurements.measurement_invariance: Same reference and rubric for both arms of a case; rehearse across selected models and prose styles.
measurements.reactivity: Participants know the time budget and that outputs are assessed.
measurements.error_model: Reference error, arm disclosure, nonresponse and late answers remain distinguishable.
measurements.blinding: Opaque IDs hide developer, model and arm metadata; self-identifying answer content is a recorded deviation.

measurements.observable: Elapsed seconds, reported active effort, model calls/failures/tokens, EAL and tool events, provider cost when returned.
measurements.instrument_or_procedure: StudyRun timestamps; gateway and operation logs; participant effort report.
measurements.scale_or_units: Seconds, minutes, call/token counts, provider currency as declared in adapter configuration.
measurements.timing: All attempts in initial and later stages, including failed attempts.
measurements.preprocessing: Restricted time is elapsed on successful on-time submission, otherwise the full budget; withdrawn/invalid is [0,budget]. Initial and later active effort are added; unknown values are not zero.
measurements.calibration: Fake-clock deadline check, failed-call ceiling check, observation reuse/expiry rehearsal; reconcile provider billing before cost claims.
measurements.reliability: Machine timestamps and retained raw responses; effort self-report has uncalibrated recall error.
measurements.validity: Measures final-decision speed and recorded resource use; does not measure intrinsic reasoning skill or subjective ease.
measurements.measurement_invariance: Equal stage budgets and call ceilings; identical pinned transition and adapter configuration within each pair.
measurements.reactivity: Instrumented gateway and elapsed budget may affect work habits.
measurements.error_model: Failed calls can have unknown billed usage; report known subtotals and missingness. Uninstrumented actions are deviations.
measurements.blinding: Participants cannot be masked to workflow; outcome raters receive no timing or arm metadata.

design.rationale: Within each identical case, randomise two independent developer teams to workflows, balancing the case and pinned model transition.
design.setting: Real developers in isolated development workspaces; synthetic rehearsal first.
design.temporal_structure: Initial session, project handover and a new model conversation with an unreleased later question.
design.assignment_method: One fair pseudorandom bit per case assigns opposite arms to two predeclared slots; seed and case ID replay allocation.
design.allocation_concealment: Operator holds the run plan and later questions; release only the assigned packet/workspace at session start.
design.masking: Reference authors independent of EAL authors; assessors masked to metadata. Participants know their workflow.
design.comparator: Ordinary developer in a new prompt session, with resulting project files and naturally produced artefacts; no experiment-authored runbook, curated previous results or earlier transcript.

units.target_population_or_system: Selected real developer teams, engineering cases and pinned model versions in a run plan.
units.sampling_frame: Purposively selected engineering tasks covering eight installed reasoning modes, reuse, expiry, context change, negative findings, objections and missing evidence.
units.experimental_unit: Developer team and two-session task sequence.
units.observational_unit: Session answer and individual recorded attempts.
units.assignment_unit: Two team slots randomised within a matched case.
units.analysis_unit: Matched case, equally weighted; neither turns nor ratings create new cases.
inclusion_criteria: Same seed and model transition in both slots
exclusion_criteria: Known pre-allocation ineligibility recorded before assignment; no outcome-based exclusions.
units.recruitment_or_selection: Trial operator recruits teams before assignment; developers cannot cross cases in confirmation. Pilot reuse is labelled dependent.

interventions_or_exposures.description: EAL/2 authorship, registration, retained source/TOML/observations and delegated reasoning/tool assessment.
interventions_or_exposures.implementation: Existing EALKnowledgeBase and ModelContextAdapter through SessionOperations; developer selects source, entry and claim.
interventions_or_exposures.dose_or_intensity: Chosen by developer within equal stage time and call budgets.
interventions_or_exposures.timing: Initial authoring and optional assessment; project handover; later assessment/reuse.
manipulation_checks: Retain registration, collection and reuse events; analyse as assigned even when adoption fails.
off_target_checks: Authoring cost and tool availability recorded; no unequal oracle access.
recovery_checks: Handover snapshot and original observation times persist; no earlier chat copied.

controls.description: Ordinary developer in a new prompt session, with resulting project files and naturally produced artefacts; no experiment-authored runbook, curated previous results or earlier transcript.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Replacing ordinary developer practice with curated experiment help.
controls.implementation: Shared seed has no study-authored EAL answer or curated handover; preserve naturally produced project files.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: If supplied knowledge differs outside treatment, causal interpretation is suspended.

controls.description: Synthetic null/nonzero/missing/dependent observations and independent scoring rehearsal.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: False certainty, dropped failures, inert estimator or invalid scorer.
controls.implementation: calibration.py and tests plus pretrial human rubric calibration.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Software failure requires repair and recheck; invalid human measurement blocks confirmation.

confounds.description: Developer learning, task difficulty and model configuration.
confounds.causal_or_measurement_path: Assignment-related differences in these factors could explain outcomes.
confounds.control_or_adjustment: Randomise within matched case/model transition; independent teams; distinct developers across confirmation cases.
confounds.diagnostic: Validate identities and transitions; report selected model transitions and deviations.
confounds.residual_risk: Human expectations, undisclosed learning and purposefully selected tasks limit interpretation and transport.

estimands.population_or_system: Predeclared different-developer/different-model cases and two eligible teams per case.
estimands.summary_measure: Equal-case mean of team-average potential-outcome differences: mean_i ((Y_iA(1)-Y_iA(0)) + (Y_iB(1)-Y_iB(0)))/2.
estimands.interpretation: Finite selected-case average correctness effect; no component mechanism or model-class effect.

estimands.population_or_system: Selected cases, by transfer stratum and model transition.
estimands.summary_measure: Paired EAL-minus-ordinary restricted later time and descriptive initial/later resource totals.
estimands.interpretation: Negative restricted-time difference suggests faster final decisions; active effort includes authoring. Secondary descriptive use.

identification.causal_and_measurement_structure: Potential outcomes fixed per team/case under each workflow; independent fair assignment makes the observed paired difference unbiased for the team-average case effect. Unknown outcomes widen the identified set.
identified_parameters: Mean assigned-workflow difference for observed outcomes; worst-case bounds with missing outcomes.
nonidentified_alternatives: Separate causal contributions of persistence, tooling and reasoning.
Effects for unselected developers or all small/large models.
rescue_actions: Withhold interpretation on invalid measurement/interference; use fresh cases after material protocol repair.

sampling.method: Purposeful coverage pilot followed by a prospectively fixed confirmation set; random assignment within cases, not random population sampling.
sampling.sample_size_or_information_target: Pilot: at least two cases per stratum; a 24-case mode-coverage pilot is a feasibility choice. Confirmation count is chosen before assignment from precision/resources.
sampling.dependence_structure: Within-pair dependence allowed. Distinct developers across confirmation cases; no shared mutable tool state or cross-case interference.
sampling.multiplicity: Only different-developer/different-model correctness is confirmatory. Secondary results are descriptive.
sampling.attrition_or_loss: Every allocated session retained; no_answer is zero, withdrawn unknown, invalid measurement blocks confirmation.
sampling.result: Hoeffding radius sqrt(2 log(40)/n). Radii .30/.20/.10 require 82/185/738 primary pairs. At 24 pairs radius is about .55.
sampling.sensitivity_analysis: calibration.py exercises null, benefit, harm, within-pair dependence, informative missingness and declared cross-case dependence; reports Monte Carlo bounds.
sampling.stopping_implications: Fixed allocated set; no extension or best-run selection after viewing outcomes. Resource infeasibility leaves a pilot or imprecise estimate.

analysis.preprocessing_lock: Record plan/version before assignment; preserve raw calls, terminal statuses and ratings separately from derived summaries.
analysis.exclusion_lock: No post-allocation exclusions; all planned sessions must be submitted or explicitly closed before ratings are locked.

models.model_or_procedure: BoundedPairedEstimator: worst-case mean bounds with two-sided Hoeffding radius; binary support [-1,1], restricted-time support [-budget,budget].

contrasts: Secondary: other transfer strata, exact model transitions, restricted time, authoring and later resources
analysis.uncertainty: Conservative marginal 95% finite-sample confidence bounds; missingness propagated without a missing-at-random assumption.
analysis.multiplicity: One prospective primary interval decision; secondary intervals are descriptive and not simultaneous.
analysis.missing_data: Explicit no_answer failure, withdrawn unknown, invalid_measurement override; unknown effort/cost/usage never treated as zero.
analysis.stopping_rule: One fixed plan and one final submission per session; within-budget retries retained and counted.
robustness_checks: Report raw correctness and late answers alongside primary endpoint.
Inspect model-transition/stratum estimates without promoting them to confirmatory findings.
software_and_versions: Python >=3.11; repository revision recorded with each trial; standard-library estimator and command adapters.
analysis.inconclusive_handling: Retain estimates and bounds, do not infer equivalence; collect new independent cases under a separately fixed follow-up plan.

decision_matrix.observation_region: Adequate confirmation count and lower interval bound above practical threshold

risks.mechanism: An answer revealing its arm can influence scoring.
risks.prevention: Independent reference and masked metadata; nonparticipant assessors.
risks.sensitivity_or_correction: Independent reassessment before interpretation; do not change the primary rule retrospectively.
risks.residual_risk: Full participant and prose blinding is impossible.

researcher_degrees_of_freedom: Task/model mixture and thresholds fixed before allocation
No optional stopping or best-run selection
negative_controls: Synthetic zero effect and informative missingness
positive_controls: Synthetic nonzero effect; held-out known correct human scoring examples
falsification_checks: Late correct answer must fail the time-bounded endpoint
Cross-case developer reuse cannot produce a confirmation interval
reporting_controls: All allocations, failures, unknowns and initial effort reported
residual_limitations: Human scorer validity still to be established

ethics_and_safety.rationale: Human developers and potentially private work artefacts participate; only isolated fixture tools are currently supplied.
risks: Unnecessary collection of identifying data or real credentials
mitigations: Use pseudonymous IDs and synthetic project data; keep participant contact details outside study files.
Tell participants the tasks, time budget and withdrawal procedure.
monitoring: Operator monitors task duration and accidental private data capture.
stopping_rules: Participant withdrawal or unintended access to non-study systems
post_stop_actions: Close session with reason, protect private material and retain only permitted de-identified records.

feasibility.access: No live provider credentials or recruited participant access has been exercised.
dependencies: Fixed task/model mixture and information budget
blockers: Real task references, participants and confirmation plan remain outstanding.
feasibility.fallback: Run a labelled feasibility pilot; report imprecision rather than weakening the comparator or interpreting synthetic answers as performance.

reproducibility.registration: No external registration required; record a dated prospective trial plan before allocation.
immutable_materials: Per-run plan copy, allocation, submitted handover snapshot and rating record; ordinary local files with digests, not a new access-control service.
reproducibility.data_plan: Retain de-identified raw calls, terminal statuses, independent ratings and derived outputs; do not publish secrets or participant identities.
reproducibility.code_plan: Code and synthetic verification tracked in the existing Git repository; no additional workflow required.
reproducibility.randomisation_or_seed_plan: Choose and record one seed before allocation; replay validates the assignment record.
reproducibility.provenance_plan: Record repository revision, plan digest, provider version/configuration, trial dates and adapter command.
reproducibility.deviation_and_amendment_plan: Record deviations alongside results; material repairs use a new prospective plan and independent cases.
reproducibility.replication_plan: Repeat with new developers, tasks and pinned models; preserve the stated comparator.

change_log: 1.0.0: specified protocol and implementation traceability; empirical execution not started.

method_selection.rationale: The practical question concerns the total effect of assigning the EAL workflow in a new session; randomise within case and pinned model transition.
method_selection.inference_framework: Frequentist randomisation-based finite selected-case estimation under no interference, with conservative bounded-observation uncertainty and worst-case missingness.
alternatives_considered: Within-developer crossover reduces variation but learning and knowledge cannot be reset; independent teams preserve the intended information contrast.
Observational developer logs improve naturalism but self-selection of EAL and model configuration confounds the workflow effect.
Component ablations answer a later mechanism question; the present treatment is the whole workflow.

sources.citation: W. Hoeffding (1963), Probability inequalities for sums of bounded random variables, JASA 58, 13-30, Theorem 2.
sources.design_consequence: Use finite-sample bounds for independent paired scores, show the conservative precision cost, and suppress intervals under declared dependence.

method_selection.information_criterion: Predeclared primary interval precision and practical threshold; quantify sample requirements and calibrate the implemented estimator.
permitted_conclusions: Assigned whole-workflow effect in the selected cases/teams and pinned configurations.
Bounded correctness benefit with separate descriptive time and resource effects.
excluded_conclusions: Performance inferred from mocks or grammar correctness
method_selection.discovery_confirmation_separation: Use pilot data for feasibility and planning only; choose the confirmation plan and threshold before assigning fresh teams/cases.

assignment.procedure: One fair pseudorandom bit per case assigns opposite arms to two predeclared slots; seed and case ID replay allocation.
assignment.failure_response: Reject illegal plan or altered allocation before opening sessions.

collection.procedure: Record all attempts, deadlines and explicit terminal states; preserve project handover.
collection.failure_response: Keep failure/unknown outcomes and reasons; invalid measurements block confirmation.

scoring.procedure: Independent rubric and two ratings plus third adjudication; human reference calibration remains planned.
scoring.failure_response: Reject structurally invalid ratings and withhold empirical inference when rubric is invalid.

analysis.procedure: BoundedPairedEstimator: worst-case mean bounds with two-sided Hoeffding radius; binary support [-1,1], restricted-time support [-budget,budget].
analysis.failure_response: Suppress intervals under declared dependence; retain missingness bounds; report inconclusive or invalid results.

verification.expected_result: Deterministic valid assignment; reject invalid confirmation/allocation.
verification.observed_result: Passed in the focused 20-test study suite; see the recorded commands and results.

verification.expected_result: Preserve denominator, unknowns and deadlines; reject changed handover.
verification.observed_result: Passed in the focused 20-test study suite; see the recorded commands and results.

verification.observed_result: Passed in the focused 20-test study suite; see the recorded commands and results.

verification.expected_result: Coverage satisfies tested null and positive effect is detected; dependent interval withheld.
verification.observed_result: Passed in the focused 20-test study suite; see the recorded commands and results.

verification.case: Six prespecified simulated data-generating scenarios, 5000 replications each.
verification.expected_result: Coverage lower Monte Carlo bound >=.95; false-benefit upper <=.05; benefit detection lower >=.80.
verification.observed_result: All prespecified simulation tolerances passed; synthetic data only.

verification.case: Paired initial/later sessions with EAL reuse/expiry and blind independent ratings.
verification.expected_result: Fresh model context, retained project, correct reuse and complete report.
verification.observed_result: Passed in the focused 20-test study suite; see the recorded commands and results.

verification.case: Independent human references and known correct/wrong/borderline scoring cases.
verification.expected_result: Reference authors justify each oracle; assessors meet the prospective rubric calibration criterion.
